entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I need to start a return for an item I purchased a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. It looks like you're referring to the Pro-Cycle jersey. What specifically is the issue with it?

Yes, that's the one. I ordered it for a cycling event, but it's the wrong size. It's just too tight across the shoulders, and I never ended up wearing it. I'd like to see about an exchange or a refund.

I understand. Let me just confirm the purchase date... Okay, I see the delivery was 66 days ago. Our policy for a standard jersey like this allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within that window, so I can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, that's great. I wasn't sure if I had missed the deadline.
Not at all. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. Would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?

A full refund would be best. Now, since I do have to package this up and drop it off, and I've had it for a bit, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? Maybe 15% off for the trouble?

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard return related to sizing, I can confirm you will receive a 100% refund for the jersey once we receive it. I've just sent that return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Alright, that's fair. A full refund works for me. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Charlie.
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
